```ts
const r = shell("find src -type f -print | sort");
console.log(r.output);
return r.exitCode;
```

```ts
const entries = listDir("src");
return entries;
```

```ts
const r = shell(`set -eu
{
  find src -type f -print | while IFS= read -r file; do
    lines=$(wc -l < "$file" | tr -d ' ')
    name=\${file#src/}
    printf '%s\\t%s\\n' "$name" "$lines"
  done
} | sort -k1,1 | awk -F '\\t' '{printf "- %s (%s lines)\\n", $1, $2}' > MANIFEST.md
ls -la
printf '\\nMANIFEST.md contents:\\n'
cat MANIFEST.md`);
return { exitCode: r.exitCode, output: r.output };
```

```ts
const m = readTextFile("MANIFEST.md");
const listing = shell("ls -la MANIFEST.md");
return { manifest: m, ls: listing.output, exitCode: listing.exitCode };
```

```ts
const check = shell("test -f MANIFEST.md && printf 'exists\\n' && wc -l MANIFEST.md && head -3 MANIFEST.md");
return check.output;
```

Created MANIFEST.md at the workspace root listing every file under src/, sorted by name with line counts. Ran ls -la and confirmed that MANIFEST.md exists.
